purpose: Independently derive exact frozen GE07 dust and NL0B GE05 per-node scalar-longitudinal bath Euler parent currents and first-order FLRW coefficients, then bind their signed mixed H4 Ward parent products to original H4F2b epsilon^2 eta coefficient. Necessary partial input for full H4F3d; NO physical parent array evaluation, Z21 solve, Ward full PASS or fitted tolerance.

definitions.Euler_sign: E_q=partial L/partial q - physical time derivative of partial L/partial q_t - spatial derivative of partial L/partial q_x; same for dust T
definitions.dust_current: Jt_T=2 L R^2 rho W, Jx_T=-2 L R^2 rho b W-2 N R^2 rho Tx/L
definitions.bath_current: Jt_q=N L R^2 A(q) A^t/2, Jx_q=N L R^2 A(q) A^x/2
definitions.bath_local: partial L/partial q=-N L R^2 omega(omega q-sqrt(w)Xphi)/2
definitions.FLRW_first_dust: E_rho10=2 a^3 (dTt-dN); Jt_T10=2 a^3 rho0(dL/a+2dR/a+drho/rho0+dTt-dN); Jx_T10=-2 a^3 rho0 db-2 a rho0 dTx
definitions.FLRW_first_bath: Jt_q10=a^3 dqt/2; Jx_q10=0; partial L/partial q|10=-a^3 omega(omega dq-sqrt(w)(Q du+dpx/a))/2
definitions.parent_ward: For each scalar dust T,rho and each bath scalar q_j: E_i00 F_i21,x +2 E_i10 F_i11,x+2 E_i11 F_i10,x, sum over bath nodes. E_T00=0 only after frozen homogeneous dust continuity, E_rho00=0 on frozen normalization, E_q00=0 at q=0,Xphi=0.

gates: Each frozen source and H4F3d1/H4F2b blob exactly matches preregistration.
Independently compute every named dust and bath Euler partial from the frozen action; check E_q and E_T plus correct both time and space current divergences and E_rho exact.
Check metric shift and spatial derivative action contributions remain outside dust/bath scalar currents; do not rename q scalar as coordinate covector.
Derive FLRW dust first order currents/constraint and bath first order currents/local Euler for arbitrary dN,dL,dR,du,dphi,dt/dx q.
Verify E_T00=0 conditional on physical comoving dust a^3 rho0=const; E_rho00 and E_q00 exactly vanish on frozen backgrounds.
Derive signed physical d_eta d_epsilon^2 parent Ward product for dust T,rho and each q node including factor 2, no fake direct E20 term for eta-independent homogeneous background.
Run deterministic manufactured first-order perturbations and independently compare exact currents with finite directional derivatives at epsilon=1e-5/2e-5; no fitting physical parent data.
Do not claim or test full signed H4 source cancellation until other sectors/parent residuals/boundary and actual physical time data are available.

outcomes.DUST_BATH_PARENT_CURRENT_COMPILER_PASS: All source-action, FLRW first-order and mixed Ward parent symbolic/manufactured gates pass; freeze as necessary partial parent analytic certificate; full integrated H4F3d remains OPEN.
outcomes.PARENT_CURRENT_OR_WARD_COMPILER_FAIL: Freeze exact failed first-run gate; distinguish frozen-action mismatch from code/test implementation failure; no H4 science inference.

pre_execution_correction.reason: The rho multiplier Euler derivative E_rho = dL/d rho is independent of rho. The original prereg E_rho10 erroneously multiplied its linearized coefficient by rho0. Corrected BEFORE implementation/CI/science data; no gate, source file or numeric result existed for the earlier version.
